Title: Listing Tracker Discord Bot
Description: Built in JS which listens and filters for new listings from the BP.TF API
Hooked up to a discord bot which creates embeds for each new listing after filtering for potential deals / low listings.

Title: Window Crawler
Description: Small Godot project that features a crawler icon roaming around your screen
Utilizes a state machine system to transition between two different states (Idle + Wander)

Title: Chess Application / Bot
Description: Implemented a C# application following the book "C#eckmate".
Expanded upon through the use of Avalonia to create a small desktop application.

Title: Monoalphabetic Substitution Decrypter
Description: A monoalphabetic substitution decrypter that utilizes genetic algorithims following Rishabh Bector's "Enigma" decrypter

Title: BeachHacks 9.0
Description: Participated in a hackathon and learned about Roblox Studio / Luau to create a arena-based pvp gamemode with a strong emphasis on movement.
Worked on the creation of the map, various bits of the UI including the ability cooldowns, and some of the movement abilities
